_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-07-02 · Session 93 (SkyReach) · Sierra's CPR blind spot FIXED (cpl-chat v24) · the SIERRA TRAINING tab is LIVE (team-only)
_status: Sierra session, two acts — both sparked by YOUR feedback. ACT 1: the CPR mystery solved. Sierra had all 16 CPR/First-Aid articulations in her data the whole time, but the search behind her ranked matches by POPULARITY (how many credit recs an exhibit has) instead of RELEVANCE — and since 76% of all exhibits carry just one rec, three-quarters of the catalog could never surface on a busy question. Fixed at the database layer (relevance ranking, live for the map.rccd.edu widget too), plus CPR/First-Aid/AED/BLS now count as one family and filler words ('check', 'again', 'MAP') no longer pollute the search. Verified end-to-end: your exact question now returns CCSF, Las Positas, Cypress with courses + units. Your two 👎 notes were the trail — the feedback loop paid for itself on day one. ACT 2 — your 'go green': the SIERRA TRAINING tab is live (team-only; sign in via Team & RACI). Two panes: the 👍/👎 FEEDBACK QUEUE (expand a row → full question + answer + note; mark it new → triaged → addressed so the queue drains) and the GAP MINER (the questions where Sierra's knowledge had nothing close, the answers where she punted, recurring themes, sliced by who was asking). Hack away with the team — everything you thumbs-down or triage becomes the work list for Phase 2 (a guidance table for same-minute answer tuning) and Phase 3 (feeding missing documents into Sierra's knowledge).
